correctness.rationale: Polar inequalities |y_i|<=1, |y_i-y_(i+1)|<=1, |y_n+y_1|<=1: any inactive edge decomposes active components as anchored integer paths; when all edges active, twisted cycle yields 2y_1=sum signs, the only odd-n half-integral polar vertices are +/- alternating one-halves. An integer feasible ternary vector is extreme iff no cyclic 000 triple; active box/edge rank argument establishes both directions. Exact 9x9 antiperiodic transfer matrix trace(T^n S) gives s_n-1 integral vertices from specified eigenspace char polys; plus odd-n two fractions gives s_n-(-1)^n facets. Independently reconstructed transfer matrix, characteristic factorization, rank tests n=3,4,5, counts (12+2,24,60+2), and current source signed-permutation definition; finite tests are corroborative.
